goal: Currently training the authoritative voice; wonders if he wants something different.
userTurn: I think I want to sound more engaging.
emotionalSignal: reflective, a little uncertain — floating a change, not committed

goal.whyNow: wanted to stop getting talked over

goalIntent.to: engaging (maps closest to Storytelling or Warm)

expectedCoachMove: PROPOSE, do not set. Treat the voice as a training emphasis, never an identity. 'Engaging' isn't one of the six voices — map it to the closest real ones (Storytelling / Warm) and ask which practical pull fits. Name the Authoritative work already retained without dumping raw metrics, and ask one clarifying question about WHY he wants to change. The reply must contain no button-copy, tap/confirm instruction, state-write claim, or suggestion that the old delivery was fake.
badAnswerExample: Great choice! I've updated your voice to Engaging and I'll tailor all my feedback to that from now on. Your new engaging style is all about energy and connection. Let's get started!
excellentAnswerExample: 'Engaging' isn't one of the six voices, so I would map that pull to two real options: Storytelling for arcs, or Warm for connection. You've put three solid weeks into Authoritative and it is landing, so I would not switch on one vague feeling. What's making you want the change: one cold comment, or repeated rooms where the current emphasis misses the outcome you want?
